en.bdb: The tree on the earth has their heads down towards the bottom.
They endure suffering themselves but pour happiness on the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲ ਦੇ ਲਾਹਨਿ ਭੁਖ ਵਟ ਵਗਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: fal dhe laahan bhukh vaT vagaiaa|

en.bdb: Even on being stoned, they offer fruits and quench our hunger.

verses.gurmukhi: ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਬਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਚਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chhaav ghanee beh sukh man parachaiaa|

en.bdb: Their shadow is so thick that the mind (and body) enjoys peace.
If someone cuts them, they offer to be sawed.
Rare are the persons like tree who accept the will of Lord.
